triples.head_surface: electrical service available matches the motor requirements
triples.head_canonical_zh: 电源与电机铭牌要求匹配检查
triples.tail_surface: check that the electrical service available matches the motor requirements stamped on the motor nameplate before connecting a motor to the incoming power
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 连接电源前核对电源与电机铭牌参数
triples.evidence_text: If the pump is driven by an electric motor, check that the electrical service available matches the motor requirements stamped on the motor nameplate before connecting a motor to the incoming power.

triples.head_canonical_zh: 电机转速符合泵规格检查
triples.tail_surface: Check that the motor speed meets pump specifications
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 核查电机转速满足泵规格
triples.evidence_text: Check that the motor speed meets pump specifications.

triples.head_surface: rotation is incorrect on a three-phase motor
triples.tail_surface: have a qualified electrician interchange any two of the three phase wires to change direction
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 由合格电工交换任意两根相线以改变转向
triples.evidence_text: If rotation is incorrect on a three-phase motor, have a qualified electrician interchange any two of the three phase wires to change direction.

triples.head_surface: rotation is incorrect on a single-phase motor
triples.tail_surface: consult the literature supplied with the motor for specific instructions
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 查阅电机随附文献获取具体纠正说明
triples.evidence_text: If rotation is incorrect on a single-phase motor, consult the literature supplied with the motor for specific instructions.
